original_fields.Title: Description household expenditure statistics
original_fields.Content: Information on New Zealand households’ expenditure, income, and material well-being is based on data collected as part of the Household Economic Survey (HES). Household expenditure is collected every three years.

original_fields.Title: Household expenditure statistics: Year ended June 2023 - key facts 1
original_fields.Content:
13 October 2025: We have added 2020 to 2023 data to seven Aotearoa Data Explorer tables on household expenditure statistics so they now provide a complete time series. Aotearoa Data Explorer changes by date gives details.

18 March 2024: We have replaced the file Detailed household expenditure: Year ended June 2023 – CSV to correct two codes in the description file that were transposed. None of the data has changed.

7 March 2024: We have reformatted data presentation in the Excel table Household expenditure statistics: Year ended June 2023 so it displays as numbers. None of the data has changed.

 

The expenditure data interval between the year ended June 2019 and the year ended June 2023 is a four-year gap, rather than the typical three-year gap of this series. The difference is due to the postponement of data collection for the year ended June 2022 Household Economic Survey in response to COVID-19 restrictions. Therefore, the change in the four years may be greater than for the typical three-year gap. Apply caution when comparing trends.
